oneOf.description: The grant ends soon (15 minutes before, DBee spec Decision 9).
A database session ended for a reason other than `sessions.close`.

apiVersion.description: The API version written into the generated client.

schemaHash.description: The schema hash the server announces; equals `SCHEMA_HASH` of the generated client.

secretStoreNote.description: Why the keychain is not used, when it is not. Display-safe.

workspacePath.description: Where the workspace lives (connections, settings, tabs, audit log). Read-only in Settings.

oneOf.description: The Tauri desktop app: one local human, no network listener.
The self-hosted web server.

ApprovalRequiredDetails.description:
`details` of an `ApprovalRequired` error raised by the authorizer: the id of the recorded
approval request.

kind.description:
The leading keyword(s) of the first statement, e.g. `SELECT`, `DROP TABLE`, or
`unparseable`.

statements.description: Statements in the text; the server runs one per call.

Code.description:
Error codes, spec §10. Serialized as the variant name so TypeScript can narrow on
`e.code === "ApprovalRequired"`.

ConnectionDraft.description: What the connection form submits to `connections.prepare` and `connections.create`.

allowedAddresses.description:
Networks (CIDR) the connection may reach. `null` proposes the addresses resolved right
now (loopback for `localhost`); a list replaces the proposal (the user widened it).

expiresAt.description: Unix milliseconds; `null` for a personal connection that does not expire.

hasSecret.description:
Whether a password is bound to the connection: supplied with `connections.create`, or
kept from the connection being replaced.

host.description: A host name or IP literal, matched exactly in the grant.

ConnectionError.description: Typed errors of the `connections` procedures (DBee spec §5, §8).

oneOf.description: A field of the draft is invalid; `field` is its camelCase name.
The host did not resolve.

The preview no longer matches the draft (or the driver, or the resolved addresses);
prepare again.
The keychain is unavailable; the connection can be created without saving the password.
The Plugin Host refused the grant.

ConnectionId.description: Input of procedures that name one connection.

ConnectionStatus.description: Status of a connection as the tree shows it.

ConnectionSummary.description: One connection as `connections.list` returns it. Never a credential or its reference.

hasSecret.description:
Whether a password is available for this connection (in the keychain, or for this
session only).

replaces.description:
The connection this one replaces (a grant-covered edit or a renewal): its grant is
revoked once the new one is active, and the connection keeps its id.

DeniedReason.description: Why a grant refused the connection.

oneOf.description: The host resolved to an address outside the grant's address policy.
The broker refused the open; the audit log has the reason.

DriverInfo.description: A database driver compiled into the core.

digest.description: `sha256:<hex>` of the driver as the grant binds it.

Empty.description:
The empty object, `{}`: the input of procedures that take nothing and the output of those
that return nothing.

maxRows.description: Row limit for this run; `null` is unlimited (DBee spec Decision 13).

statementKind.description: The classifier's kind of the statement.

oneOf.description: Streamed to the client as chunks (a download on web).
Written by the core to the path behind a handle from `files.chooseSavePath`.

ExportOptions.description: Encoding options (DBee spec §3.8). `delimiter` and `quote` apply to CSV only.

nullText.description: Text written for NULL (CSV and TSV); empty by default.

path.description: The file written, for the `file` destination.

GrantPreview.description: What an approver sees before `connections.create` (Plugin Host spec §3, DBee spec §3.4).

approver.description: Who approves: the principal of this session.

proposedAddresses.description: The address policy the grant will carry (CIDR). Only these may be connected to.

resolvedAddresses.description: What the host resolved to right now.

secretBinding.description:
Whether a password will be stored in the secret store and released only to this
connection.

template.description: The network template the grant binds, `db-transport`.

expiresAt.description: Unix milliseconds; `null` for a grant that does not expire.

oneOf.description: The statement does not parse; `position` is a one-based character offset.
The database session is gone, or the statement could not be sent.
The grant ended while the statement ran; its outcome on the database is unknown.

SavePath.description: A chosen save path: an opaque one-time handle the core resolves, and the name to show.

SecretInput.description: The credential, write-only. Its `Debug` output names the type only.

SecretStoreKind.description: Where passwords go (DBee spec §4, Open question 2).

oneOf.description: The OS keychain: passwords persist across restarts.

No keychain is available: passwords are asked per session, kept in core memory only and
zeroized when the session ends. Nothing is persisted.

SessionError.description: Typed errors of `sessions.*` and `schema.*` (DBee spec §8, mapping every `DbError`).

oneOf.description: No answer from the host in time.

The connection has no password and the keychain holds none: ask the user and call
`connections.setSecret` for this session.
The database reported an error.
A query tab's session: one per tab.
The schema browser's session: one per connection, reused.

SetWorkspaceInput.description:
Input of `app.setWorkspace`. A document left out (or `null`) is not changed; a document given
must be a JSON object of at most [`MAX_WORKSPACE_DOCUMENT_BYTES`] serialized.

baseRevision.description:
The revision the client last read or wrote; a different current revision is a
`Conflict` and nothing is written.

SqlRisk.description: Risk of a statement, as the fail-closed classifier sees it (Ambidex spec §8).

schema.description: `null` lists what the session's search path makes visible.

TlsDraft.description: TLS policy as the form submits it (DBee spec §3.3). The server name defaults to the host.

caPem.description: One or more CA certificates, PEM.

fingerprint.description:
SHA-256 of the server certificate's DER encoding, as `sha256:<hex>`, with or without
colons, as the DBA gives it.

TlsKind.description: Transport security of a connection, as the list shows it (DBee spec §3.3).

oneOf.description: TLS required, verified against the deployment CA bundle.
TLS required, verified against a pinned CA certificate.
TLS required, the server must present exactly the pinned certificate.
Plaintext. Offered only because the first-party template says `tls = "optional"`.

TlsPreview.description: TLS policy as the approval dialog states it.

pinned.description: What is pinned: `sha256:<hex>` of each pinned CA or server certificate.

serverName.description: The name (or IP) the certificate must match; `null` for plaintext.

UpdateConnectionInput.description:
Input of `connections.update`: the fields a grant does not cover. Anything else is refused
with `InvalidArgument` (use prepare and create with `replaces`).

colour.description: An empty string clears the colour.

description.description: An empty string clears the description.

WorkspaceDocuments.description:
Output of `app.getWorkspace`: the UI's documents of the workspace (`settings.json`,
`tabs.json`) and their revision. The core stores the documents whole and never interprets
them; their layout and its version are the UI's.

revision.description: Changes with every write; opaque. Pass it back as `baseRevision`.

settings.description: `null` until the UI first writes it.

tabs.description: `null` until the UI first writes it.

oneOf.description:
The documents changed since `baseRevision` (another window wrote them); nothing was
written. `revision` is the current one.
`document` (`settings` or `tabs`) is not a JSON object or is too large.

A workspace file could not be written; nothing changed. (Not `Internal`: the router
scrubs those, and the UI shows this message.)
